messages:
deploybot: [DEPLOYBOT] Canary health degraded for embed-service in us-west1: 13% 5xx, p95 +150ms. Automated pause engaged. Need expedited decision: pin to previous stable image or abort rollout.

anya: Copy. Any customer-facing incidents reported?

kevin: A few external requests returning empty vectors. Traces point to a quantization desync in v1.4.0. Recommend pin to redwood/embed:v1.3.9-stable and scale down canary.

anya: Agree. Ops, can you perform the pin and monitor for 15m? I'll update release notes.

ops_oncall: I can run the pin now and watch metrics. If error_rate remains >5% after 10m, we'll escalate to SRE and open incident channel.

kevin: executing:
```
/releasebot pin --service embed-service --image redwood/embed:v1.3.9-stable --reason "canary regressions v1.4.0" --priority expedited --owner kevin
```

releasebot: Pin received. Verifying image signature and policy... OK. Applying pin and rebalancing traffic (ETA ~30s).

deploybot: Reroute complete. All traffic now on redwood/embed:v1.3.9-stable. v1.4.0 canaries scaled to zero.

anya: Drafted short note: "Pinned to v1.3.9 due to canary regressions in v1.4.0 (quantization mismatch). Investigation assigned to kevin." Link: https://redwood.internal/releases/notes/1818181818

ops_oncall: Monitoring: error_rate back to baseline ~0.6%, p95 normalized. Holding for 15m per policy.

kevin: Started bisect on quant flags and CI artifact comparison. Will post updates in the issue.

ops_oncall: +18m stable, no regressions. Closing expedite window and marking thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
